notes.title: Forager: Evolved
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/7129875eb036d22bf388e2c41bcab618e45e213a.jpg[/img]

Hey Foragers!

As I mentioned in the past, I believe that gamers know what's best for the games they play and love. This is why we have worked to create so many free content updates for Forager players over the past year, and this is why despite the technical difficulties we decided to allow [b]full modding support[/b] for the game.

I am very pleased to announce that after months of work, the efforts of the Forager community and our amazing audio designer and programmer Topher produced [b]a new official free content expansion for the game![/b]


[h1]Gather the energy of the sun with Forager: Evolved![/h1]

[previewyoutube=2x8ZL6ddDGk;full][/previewyoutube]

Forager: Evolved is an official collection of mods, content and fixes for the game developed by Topher in collaboration with the Forager community. Here are the main features:

[h2]New Structures:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Solar Panel:[/b] Has four tiers, produces solar energy during the day
[*] [b]Lunar Panel:[/b] Has four tiers, produces solar energy during the night
[*] [b]Solar Workbench:[/b] Enables solar crafting!
[*] [b]Metabolic Infuser:[/b] Automatically heals HP and Energy over time in a radius
[*] [b]Fracturing Rig:[/b] Automatically produces Petroleum
[*] [b]Industrial Grinder:[/b] Causes nearby ores to drop extra items
[*] [b]Solar Kiln:[/b] When placed next to a Solar Drill, produces ingots, bricks and glass
[*] [b]Solar Drill:[/b] Automatically produces coal, iron, and gold
[*] [b]Cable:[/b] Connects structures to Panels
[/list]

[h2]New Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Solar Powered Hammer
[*] Capacitor
[*] Gold Gear
[*] Iron Gear
[*] Machine Casing
[*] Petroleum
[*] Solar Cell
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/dd40458fac78ed5375f3ae3afbf3cb07cae2c497.png[/img]

Forager: Evolved also contains some of the best mods the Forager community has developed so far, fully integrated and updated to work with a single click:

[list]
[*] [b]Big Bundle of Cosmetics[/b] by bee:
[i]Adds over 160+ new cosmetics to the game[/i]

[*] [b]Biome-Specific Structure Variants[/b] by bee:
[i]New structure variants for each biome[/i]

[*] [b]Kyo's Fast Learning[/b] by Kyo:
[i]Speeds up the skill learning animation[/i]

[*] [b]Extra Food Mod![/b] by bee and Ryan:
[i]Adds more food to craft[/i]

[*] [b]Ultimate Building & Cosmetic Menus[/b] by topherlicious:
[i]Complete overhaul for the build menu and cosmetic menu[/i]

[*] [b]Build Grid[/b] by topherlicious:
[i]Adds a visible grid when building new structures[/i]

[*] [b]Craftable Wardrobe[/b] by topherlicious:
[i]Allows the player to craft a wardrobe anywhere[/i]

[*] [b]Droid Visibility Changer[/b] by  WanSou:
[i]Gives the player the ability to change the visibility of droids[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/306182cd8a5b738ca69097708f5feda96c45dd29.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2147146084][h1]Install the full expansion here![/h1][/url]


Happy Foraging!

Hello Foragers!

Today I wanted to talk to you about what's next in Forager's future...


[h3]In case you haven't heard yet, these are the things that are confirmed to come soon:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer Mode
[*] Content Updates for Switch & PS4 (All the released updates!)
[*] Xbox GamePass Version (Base game + ALL updates)

It is because players like you loved Forager so much and provided me and the dev team with SO MUCH feedback and ideas that we were able to release [b]all the content updates for FREE for EVERYONE![/b] 🎉



[h2]Also, the console updates are officially done! Yay![/h2]

Development of these took a while so I want to personally thank every Forager player for their patience and support. I care so much for this community that I couldn't stand to see the console versions being several updates behind in content... I hope you enjoy all the new free stuff!

[b]I will announce the release date for the updates as soon as Nintendo, Sony, and Microsoft all confirm their dates![/b]




[h2]On other news, Forager has been nominated for best GameMaker game![/h2]

I want to continue to support this game for as long as you guys want me to, so please let me know if you want me to add more content/features to Forager or if I should get started on the next game in the Forager universe.

And remember, if you like Forager, all the free updates and the transparency in the dev process, please vote for the game!

Happy Foraging!

notes.title: HopFrog answers your questions about Forager!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/bd2a7ff619abce9af8941fe5939f7157e96b2f71.png[/img]

Hey Foragers!

I will be answering questions I get the most often again! If you are interested in having a question answered, I will be doing more Q&A sessions like these in the future so leave me your questions down here in the comments or [url=discord.gg/HopFrog]on our Discord server![/url]





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/4e779c4f66e76854c3e9b0a6d46e5b7b7dfd488f.png[/img]

[b]Yes! We are currently working on the multiplayer update and we expect it to be done sometime this year (2020)[/b]. So far it's going great and we are trying to decide how many new things we want to add to the game. Would you prefer to wait longer and have new content to play with your friends? Or should we just focus on getting multiplayer ready ASAP and add content later? Let me know!





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/03e3be78103d1d61c6bd6ca1c690547828f6babd.png[/img]

We could definitely do something with the late-game Void! I have a few ideas myself, but [b]what kind of things are you interested in?[/b] Should we make some new super-difficult void exclusive bosses with special drops/rewards?





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/d9b1d1a0d09921dab375197c48610f4c8a0e71df.png[/img]

Absolutely! I am sorry this is taking so long, but it will definitely be worth it! Updates for consoles are being worked on by an external team and they are [b]very very very good at it[/b]... They are MUCH better programmers than I am so you can expect the game to run MUCH better and have FEWER bugs soon. I have so much faith in their work, it's going to be great [b]when the updates are available later this year![/b] [b]PS4 and Switch players will be getting ALL the updates they are missing[/b] probably all at once (Appreciation + Combat + Nuclear)





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/aaba8f0352f0003c0b16e915d6ce7644439ec311.png[/img]

I love this idea! If no mods do this I will consider us officially supporting it in future content 👍





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/973b163f99318e6a641ea2929f0a43150e8a85c0.png[/img]

Right now we are testing several different things. I like having colored arrows + player names but I also want to add some more cosmetic customization options. As you know, every time you get an achievement in Forager you unlock a brand new cosmetic item to customize your character with. Should we add more cosmetic items with Multiplayer? Or is it better to just stick to colored arrows/names?





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/043cd431d113b0164ca5b4f0eb12e00fffb3256b.png[/img]

I am glad you liked the game! We have more content and updates coming for freeeee! ːwinter2019happybulbː





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/3436db8978f1e94045b06dc0c7d3366c7f2b537f.png[/img]

Great question! I have always said I will keep working on Forager for as long as you guys want me to. So... do you want more content after Multiplayer? If so, what kind of things are you interested in?

Additionally, would you be interested in new Forager-related games? I love the characters, aesthetics, and gameplay and have a few ideas that may be fun! 

[list]
[*] [b]Colony sim[/b] Forager focused on keeping your forager village healthy and happy?

[*] [b]City Builder[/b] Forager focused on creating a huge sprawling kingdom?

[*] [b]Roguelike[/b] Forager focused on combat and digging/exploration?
[/list]

Please let me know what would you like to see next from the Forager team!





[h1]That's it for today! If you would like to have a question answered, please comment it down below or [url=discord.gg/HopFrog]join our Discord server to ask me directly![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Devs LOVE the Forager community! (+Giveaway) 💖🎁
notes.content:
Happy Valentine's, Foragers!

Forager players have helped us SO much since the release of the game. It's thanks to your constant feedback, testing, and suggestions that we were able to create [b]non-stop constant big free updates for this game![/b]

We are deeply committed to making Forager the best it can be and to giving back to this amazing community, so today we are going to look at all the ways we appreciate your passion for Forager 💖

[list]
[*] [h2]Discord Participation Rewards[/h2]

notes.title: Meet the Forager dev team!
notes.content:
Hey Foragers!

When Forager first came out back in April, gamers all around the world told me they liked the game and they were excited about its future potential. I originally thought the game was 100% done and was ready to move on. But then noticed people leaving comments such as [b]"It's a great base! Make more content for it!"[/b].

Why not add more content? Why not add more lands/items/skills/enemies/biomes/etc? There truly was a great base to work with. Gamers were right!

So I came up with a plan! I took the money Forager made and decided to put it back to development so we can keep [b]expanding the game for everyone for FREE![/b]


The main issue I noticed is that a single person can't possibly expand a game as quickly as I wanted, so I hired a bunch of awesome people to help! [u][b]Today I want to introduce you to the current Forager dev team:[/b][/u]

[h1][url=https://twitter.com/_HopFrog]HopFrog (Design/Business)[/url][/h1]

Heya! I’m lazyeye, a game dev from the Chicagoland area. I taught myself how to make video games while I was in college and eventually dropped out to start coding them as a career. About a year later I met Hop and helped him optimize Forager, and now I’m the lead programmer for the game! Blame any bugs on Nomm, though, not me. ;)

Hi, I'm Nommiin! I'm an 18-year-old self-taught programmer from the US! I got into game development with the dream of making a Metroid fan-game in GameMaker! notes.title: Combat Update now available!
notes.content:
Hey Foragers!

It's finally time! [b]The Combat Update is upon us![/b]

This update has been the most ambitious undertaking we have tackled ever since the game released! The goal was to add more challenging encounters, to ease out the power curve and to improve the gameplay length.

Remember, I want to keep working on this game for years to come so let me know what would you like to see in the future!

Check out the official new trailer!

[previewyoutube=33nSGFwjNWY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]New Content and Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New Biome/Dungeon: The Void.[/b]
New procedural endless world players can travel to late in the game. You must defeat all enemies before the time runs out, or you will be teleported out! Defeating all the enemies in time will allow you to continue to the next level of the Void. Each time you progress, enemies will become stronger and more diverse, but your rewards will increase as well!

[*] [b]New Game Mode: Hard Mode.[/b]
Hard Mode is available directly from the main menu when creating new savefiles, and it allows you to play Forager in a MUCH more difficult setting. All enemies are stronger and will attack your base, new enemies will also appear at night, and resource costs are increased!

[*] [b]New Gear and Item Tiers: Void and Cosmic.[/b]
Two new and powerful tiers of gear that offer higher stats and new abilities, crafted from materials gained from content added in this update.

[*] [b]Improved Combat Difficulty.[/b]
All enemies have increased stats, and some of them have improved AI and new combat moves! ALL Bossfights are also more difficult now!

[*] [b]New Enemies and Bosses.[/b]
Face off against powerful new foes!

[*] [b]Pets.[/b]
Unlock your own personal pet through the new Pet skill in the Foraging branch!

[*] [b]Starfalls.[/b]
Legends say during the darkest nights, stars will randomly fall from the sky and Foragers everywhere are free to mine them for goodies!

[*] [b]Railroads.[/b]
Go deep into the Industry branch of skills to unlock Railroads and Locomotives! These contraptions will allow you to move quickly through your giant base!

[*] [b]Boss-Summoning Sigils.[/b]
Fight new powerful late-game bosses by summoning them on your base! You will be able to fully create and customize an arena to give you an advantage over them!

[*] [b]New Secret NPC.[/b]
There is a new secret trader NPC that only spawns at night and will sell rare items!

[*] [b]Skill Grid Rework.[/b]
A lot of the boring/useless skills have been reworked or removed, and new ones have been added!

[*] [b]Game Balance/Pacing Rework.[/b]
Improved pacing and difficulty! Finally! Players won't be able to unlock overpowered skills and gear TOO early anymore, making the pacing smoother and gameplay longer!

[*] [b]New Inventory Menu.[/b]
New design and new features! Sort items manually, Send items to Vaults automatically, Add/Remove items from your Toolbar and full item descriptions!

[*] [b]New Crafting Menu.[/b]
New design and new features! Infinite crafting, Pinned recipes and full item descriptions!

[*] [b]Vault Locking.[/b]
You are now able to lock slots on Vaults to make sure only the specified item goes in it!

[*] [b]100 New Items![/b]

[*] [b]A TON of Bugfixes![/b]
[/list]


Let me know what you think of this update and what other updates we should make in the future!

Happy Foraging!

notes.title: Forager Combat Update - Open Beta!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/5d55d0b744a4e5cb42af5a349d04edd6ccb7d7cf.png[/img]

Hey Foragers!

The Combat Update is almost 100% done! It will be completely done in a couple of weeks!


Meanwhile, if you would like to help us test this update to find bugs, balance issues and other problems please join us on this Open Beta!


[b]For the time being, the beta is only available on Steam and Windows, and only has new localized text for English.[/b]


[h1]Please note that playing on beta versions of Forager may be unstable, and could permanently corrupt your save data/crash at any time![/h1]


[b]How to Play the Open Beta:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right-click on Forager in your Steam library
[*] Go to properties
[*] Click on the “BETAS” tab
[*] Select “beta” from the dropdown
[/list]


I will post a detailed changelog whenever the update is finished, but for now here is what's new:


[h1]New Content and Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]New Biome/Dungeon: The Void.[/b]
[i]New procedural endless world players can travel to late in the game. You must defeat all enemies before the time runs out, or you will be teleported out! Defeating all the enemies in time will allow you to continue to the next level of the Void. Each time you progress, enemies will become stronger and more diverse, but your rewards will increase as well![/i]

[*] [b]New Game Mode: Hard Mode.[/b]
[i]Hard Mode is available directly from the main menu when creating new savefiles, and it allows you to play Forager in a MUCH more difficult setting. All enemies are stronger and will attack your base, new enemies will also appear at night, and resource costs are increased! For now, there is no permadeath, but we will experiment some more and add it if players like the challenge. So let me know what you think![/i]

[*] [b]New Gear and Item Tiers: Void and Cosmic.[/b]
[i]Two new and powerful tiers of gear that offer higher stats and new abilities, crafted from materials gained from content added in this update.[/i]

[*] [b]Improved Combat Difficulty.[/b]
[i]All enemies have increased stats, and some of them have improved AI and new combat moves! ALL Bossfights are also more difficult now![/i]

[*] [b]New Enemies and Bosses.[/b]
[i]Face off against powerful new foes![/i]

[*] [b]Pets[/b].
[i]Unlock your own personal pet through the new Pet skill in the Foraging branch![/i]

[*] [b]Starfalls.[/b]
[i]Legends say during the darkest nights, stars will randomly fall from the sky and Foragers everywhere are free to mine them for goodies![/i]

[*] [b]Railroads.[/b]
[i]Go deep into the Industry branch of skills to unlock Railroads and Locomotives! These contraptions will allow you to move quickly through your giant base![/i]

[*] [b]Boss-Summoning Sigils.[/b]
[i]Fight new powerful late-game bosses by summoning them on your base! You will be able to fully create and customize an arena to give you an advantage over them![/i]

[*] [b]New Secret NPC.[/b]
[i]There is a new secret trader NPC that only spawns at night and will sell rare items![/i]

[*] [b]Skill Grid Rework.[/b]
[i]A lot of the boring/useless skills have been reworked or removed, and new ones have been added![/i]

[*] [b]Game Balance/Pacing Rework.[/b]
[i]Improved pacing and difficulty! Finally! Players won't be able to unlock overpowered skills and gear TOO early anymore, making the pacing smoother and gameplay longer![/i]

[*] [b]New Inventory Menu.[/b]
[i]New design and new features! Sort items manually, Send items to Vaults automatically, Add/Remove items from your Toolbar and full item descriptions![/i]

[*] [b]New Crafting Menu.[/b]
[i]New design and new features! Infinite crafting, Pinned recipes and full item descriptions![/i]

[*] [b]Vault Locking.[/b]
[i]You are now able to lock slots on Vaults to make sure only the specified item goes in it![/i]

[*] [b]100 New Items![/b]

[*] [b]A TON of Bugfixes![/b]
[/list]


[url=discord.gg/HopFrog][h1][b]Please join us on Discord to let us know what we should change or if you find any bugs![/b][/h1][/url]



That's all for now, Happy Foraging! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: In Forager the real enemy is your own ennui
notes.content:
What I like about Forager is that it has survival and crafting but the hunger meter's not an annoyance. There are always berry bushes nearby, and you only get hungry when you're actively mining or digging or whatever. I can alt-tab out, leaving my forge and banks running, without worrying I'll come back to find I've wasted away. It's not so much Don't Starve as Don't Worry About Starving, It's Fine Actually.

In Forager you're a little wisp of a character who hits trees and rocks and slime monsters with a pick to gather ingredients, then combines those ingredients into new stuff (buildings, wallets, a better pick that is covered in slime for some reason). If that stuff is money you can use it to buy new islands, though it's not explained who is selling them or why they only appear in the middle of the blank ocean if you hand over some coins. It's not worth thinking too hard about the backstory of Forager—the explanation for everything is "because it's a videogame".

It's like if you took the village and most of the farming out of Stardew Valley. I'm usually either on a quest—maybe collecting demon horns to help a ghost look more scary or trying to craft enough potions to fill a display in the museum—or just gathering whatever I need to buy the next upgrade or island. I run a loop of the land digging up sand and coal while keeping an eye out for rare flowers before checking my fish traps again.

When you die in Forager, maybe to a surprise slime or a spike trap, you can reload an autosave from seconds before that moment. There's no cost to death, which makes it easy to play without paying much attention. There's also no cost to waiting around for things to respawn or finish being manufactured in one of your buildings, which means the easiest way to gather the rare ingredients which become vital as you work your way up the skill tree is to just kick back for a while.

Forager is the kind of game I play without focusing on it. I don't often listen to podcasts while I play games because I like to keep my attention on one thing at a time, but Forager isn't engaging enough on its own. I've made it through a bunch of episodes of a podcast about old-school RPG modules thanks to Forager giving me something to do with my hands but not much to do with my brain.

Occasionally there's a puzzle or a dungeon with a boss in it, but the combat's very superficial. Now that I've got a bow that freezes enemies and 100 cooked meat in my inventory I'm unstoppable, and even if I die that just means a reload. The biggest challenge in Forager is conquering the feeling that I'm wasting my time playing it, that I've become hooked on another game that spits out rewards and achievements and makes numbers go up, and that I'll regretfully uninstall in another day or two.

On the other hand, I really have made a serious dent in my podcast backlog.

notes.title: Forager Update Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey Foragers!

Wow! I have been so incredibly overwhelmed with the support! Thank you so much for playing Forager and for providing feedback, thanks to your great ideas and suggestions I managed to rework the update roadmap for future Forager content.

The main points raised are as follows:

[list]
[*] Accessibility options are nice but we need to do more/better and secret options should be moved to the ingame config menus

[*] Core gameplay is addictive but it ends too soon (~20 hours and then nothing to do anymore)

[*] The game's pacing feels wrong (Automation and Droids can make things TOO easy, some Gear items are too cheap while others are too expensive, there is idle downtime way too often while you wait for things to craft or spawn, etc)

[*] Combat is not challenging/rewarding

[*] Some quality of life changes are needed (inventory sorting, better save backups, removal of sound stacking for Mining Rods, etc)
[/list]

Our updates from now on will focus on increasing gameplay length and adding replayability! Check it out:


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/8e02e933a2278e6c85be4ef91e7d84772cdd731c.jpg[/img]

Developer: HopFrog

This is a public service announcement: if you find yourself on the western edge of the Ll n Peninsula in Wales anytime soon on the hunt for blackberries, don t bother – I ve picked them all. Turns out there s a twofold satisfaction to foraging that makes it difficult to stop. First there s the search: looking high and low for collectibles, pushing your body further into the thicket, gently squeezing the fruit to test whether it s ready. Then there s the count: two foragers competing to fill their tupperware boxes to the top with ripe goods. Does the berry belong to the spotter, or the forager who could reach it? The debate ends only when there are no berries left to argue over.

Forager, the game, knows the lure of both the search and the count, and is built to exploit both. It blends together idle game mechanics with active exploration, farming, crafting and combat, and has a dangerous advantage over the Welsh coast: everything in Forager grows back fast. Not just the plants, but the cows, the gold deposits, and the gravestones that house the living dead – all renewed within a matter of minutes.

Forager has been in development for 2.5 years so far. That's quite a while! [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game_development]Not too bad compared to the average though:[/url]

[quote=Wikipedia]Most modern PC or console games take from one to three years to complete, where as a mobile game can be developed in a few months. The length of development is influenced by a number of factors, such as genre, scale, development platform and number of assets.

Some games can take much longer than the average time frame to complete. An infamous example is 3D Realms' Duke Nukem Forever, announced to be in production in April 1997 and released fourteen years later in June 2011. Planning for Maxis' game Spore began in late 1999; the game was released nine years later in September 2008. The game Prey was briefly profiled in a 1997 issue of PC Gamer, but was not released until 2006, and only then in highly altered form. Finally, Team Fortress 2 was in development from 1998 until its 2007 release, and emerged from a convoluted development process involving "probably three or four different games", according to Gabe Newell.[/quote]

[b]Forager has been delayed for a total of 4 months[/b]. That's not nearly as bad as most videogames in this decade!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791461855993/announcements/detail/3309483930414272712]I explained the reasons behind the delays on this post.[/url] Here is the TLDR:

[list]
    [*] I signed a contract that required me to release all console versions and PC versions simultaneously. Console versions notoriously take longer to develop (since you need to port the game to a new system). I had no idea how that worked and overestimated how long the process usually takes. [b]Total beginner mistake, but this is my first ever commercial videogame after all![/b]

    [*] The game was technically "ready" in November 2018, but it wasn't nearly as good as it is now. Over time the community made me understand there are some things that NEEDED to be in the game, so it can be the best version of Forager possible. [b]I decided to work on these things so I could release on Steam the BEST version of Forager that I could.[/b] Stuff like Mac and Linux support, cosmetic items and costumes, build and terrain replacement, more creative options for buildings, a better endgame, more combat based encounters, better farming aspects, mod support, multiplayer, etc...
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/138f180ac0596e76758187fb75bb938da67a4978.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/12ed7c3118d61033ceb36f5de197aaa600f98bba.png[/img]
Soon™
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/138f180ac0596e76758187fb75bb938da67a4978.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/82a262dd6b047c1416c2840044b121cd6e579f83.png[/img]
It's honestly crazy how much better the game got since I mistakenly said it was "ready" back in November. Here is a detailed list:

[list]
[*] Additional desktop exclusive options to disable screen effects, shakes and other accessibility options.

[*] 8 new items and 1 new structure, each with their own new sprite assets.

[*] 10 quality of life improvement or optimizations. They are all detailed [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/beta-7-is-out-23290152]here[/url], [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/beta-8-is-out-24724114]here [/url]and [url=https://trello.com/b/NkahLQ5c/forager]here[/url].

[*] 71 new bugfixes.

[*] 4 new music tracks.

[*] Discord rich presence support for Desktop builds.

[*] Mac version support.

[*] Linux version support.

[*] Massive file size optimization for all music files in the game.

[*] Error handling system that sends error reports from desktop to our server. Integrated with both Discord and Trello.

[*] Feature suggestion system for desktop, that lets players suggest features directly to us. Integrated with Discord, Trello, and Nolt.

[*] Automatic savefile backups for desktop.

[*] New main menu system with detailed development roadmap, community links and extra unlockable content (such as comic books, concept art with dev notes and the game's development story).

[*] Rebindable key support for both desktop and consoles.

[*] Code optimization reworks, bringing FPS to constant 60 for all platforms.

[*] Initial work on Mod Support for the Steam Workshop.

[*] Initial work on the PC-exclusive multiplayer version.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/138f180ac0596e76758187fb75bb938da67a4978.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/6459e7c5171197e3b76ce7d13737d67f4df95c02.png[/img]
Multiplayer work has recently just started. It's going to take a while because we need to rework the entire game's systems to be compatible with several players at once. I have a lot of ideas on how it will work but here are some things I know for sure:

[list]
[*] I want it to be able to support at least 4 players at once on the same world.

[*] I want it to be able to support local multiplayer as well, maybe with splitscreens?

[*] I want to add more free content so there are fun projects for severla people to work together towards. Think something super hard that requires teamwork: New dungeons with difficult bossess, Building a spacerocket and exploring other worlds, Teleporting to super hard versions of the current biomes, etc...
[/list]

As for free DLC, the game will get free updates and DLC thanks to our Patreon supporters! This includes at least 6 big updates that will come right after the game releases, but I will keep working on free updates and DLC for as long as you guys want me to!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/138f180ac0596e76758187fb75bb938da67a4978.png[/img]

Because it was not finished! I had to wait until the console versions were ready, so why not use that time to make the PC version better anyway? There are several groups of people following Forager's development. Some of them complain and insult me on Steam forums, the others join the Discord server, participate with the community, post guides and tutorials, and donate money for development so I can improve the game and buy food for my family. I assure you Forager's fans have been playing the game for a while now, and they send me their feedback and suggestions every single month!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/138f180ac0596e76758187fb75bb938da67a4978.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/ffd8b457974ac75630c35b2a55a85c21c26d6162.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/138f180ac0596e76758187fb75bb938da67a4978.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/a8b50963a5cc9d9542c9cd664498bb02a0f91f9f.png[/img]
We have established that I need to release all game versions simultaneously. [b]Early Access is legally the same as an official game release.[/b] If I did EA I would get sued for breach of contract. That's why I do Patreon, as a donation platform, it doesn't legally count as having released the game on a storefront yet!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/138f180ac0596e76758187fb75bb938da67a4978.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/cebef73706e30f4287cb087428075c3a0a7b8f1a.png[/img]
I honestly just thought it would be cool! I loved videogames ever since I was a kid and I always dreamed of having shirts made out of some of my games.

A lot of your favorite videogames offered players merch before they released (Binding of Isaac, Ooblets, Celeste, Cuphead, Super Meat Boy and Darkest Dungeon come to mind, I am sure there are many many more). And some of them delay their launches even more than Forager. 

I really didn't think it was going to upset the community this much, and for that, I apologize. The worst part is that [b]developers actually make almost no money with merch sales[/b] since they are much lower than game sales and also give a MUCH lower net revenue percentage.

[b]It was 100% because I thought it would be cool, and I always dreamed to have shirts and plushies of my games. I am so sorry if I offended you by doing this. I swear it was not my intention![/b]

I care about what the community thinks because this is the first time in my life I am actually on the other side. I was always just part of the community, and this time I am the actual dev. It's super weird and I never get fully used to it.

I want people to like me and I want them to like my game. I spent so much time and effort and money working on it and I feel it's something really special!

notes.title: Why is Forager taking so long?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today I want to address the current situation with Forager and the constant lack of release date announcements.

As I have said in the past, the reason Forager was delayed back from it's November 2018 release date was that the console versions of the game weren't done yet, and for contractual reasons, I needed to release all of the game's versions at the same time. (PC, PS4 and Nintendo Switch).


We are now in the middle of January and I am honestly still not sure how long this process will take. I have several estimates on when could be the earliest release date, but all of them are just speculation at this point.


Forager is my first ever "real" game, and there are lot of things I am learning how to do on the job. One of them is communicating with this amazing community and trying to keep expectations managed. I made a mistake putting dates and numbers to when I thought the game would be ready, and because of that the team and I are under a lot of stress trying to get this done so everyone has a chance to play the finished game at the same time. This is all my fault.


The console versions are almost done, but I don't want to announce possible release date windows anymore in case I am wrong again. [b]From now on, I will not announce any type of release date window until I am 100% sure we can actually release that day/month.[/b] I know for sure Forager is releasing soon, but I am not exactly sure when.


[h1]Now let me give you some good news![/h1]

Since the console ports are still under work, I took the last couple of months as an opportunity to improve the game and add more free content. Everyone that played Beta 7 knows of the new features, [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/beta-7-is-out-23290152]which are conveniently listed here! [/url]


Additionally, I have added some new things, fixed some annoying bugs and hired a very talented programmer that has actually improved the performance of the game [b]GREATLY[/b]. I am talking about constant 60 fps, even in the super late game! 


Due to the recent reworks in code systems to improve performance, I think it's a good idea to do some massive testing before we officially release. [b]This is why there will be a Beta 8 in the near future.[/b] My goal is to get this done by the end of January or the first week of February.


Beta 8 will contain some new features and reworks that I haven't announced yet plus [url=https://trello.com/b/NkahLQ5c/forager]all the things added and fixed that are currently visible on the official development Trello board. [/url]


We have now entered the final stretch and this is a very stressful time for us, so I would like to thank you all for your patience and continued support and once again apologize for all the dumb mistakes I have made while trying to finish this amazing passion project of mine.

I would also like to note that [url=https://www.patreon.com/hopfrog]thanks to the supporters on Patreon[/url], [b]Forager will get FREE DLC updates for EVERYONE on ALL PLATFORMS![/b] There will be plenty of new content added to the game even after it releases!


[u][b]Forager WILL be great and I promise I won't let you down![/b][/u]

notes.title: Beta 7 preview
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today I will be talking through some of the features I got to implement for Beta 7 as a result of the recent delay in Forager's release date. 

Beta 7 will be released next week, [b]on Thursday 13th of December.[/b] If you do not have a closed beta key, [url=https://hopfrogsa.net/blog/2018/8/8/the-forager-closed-beta-starts-now]please read this![/url]

Here are a few of the things I have added:


[h1]LANDFILL:[/h1]

This is a new item crafted at the [b]Flower Press[/b] that lets you put blocks of land anywhere you want! This is functionally the same as building a [b]Bridge[/b], but it allows for some prettier base building and customization. Additionally, you may even plant and harvest crops in these land tiles!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/faa8924c0adcf76b2c03884b70294b4b0ddcd507.gif[/img]


[h1]ASSIGN DROIDS TO BUILDINGS:[/h1]

You may now assign Droids to most buildings by pressing right click when selection them:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/0a3afd42c42495630a18329287a20884eedd2a50.gif[/img]

This will solve the problem of having too many droids as they will just stay there "powering" the building (which grants it an increased bonus in efficiency!)

Once you need the Droid again for mining or enemy slaying, just come back to pick him up and continue your adventure!


[h1]NECRO ROD:[/h1]

Another new item! This one is a Gear piece found in the [b]Skull Maze[/b]. It works like any other Rod in the sense that it has a charge but a very powerful effect. In this case, it summons skeletons!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/45bcaa098834c3bb2178b018050ac1a5010a8380.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/7c0a84fff6648d4431896609e472f9a82418c52d.png[/img][/url]

Why would you want to summon skeletons? The big ones now drop a new item called the [b]Great Skull:[/b]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/c501e448a0bdf6bfdc90ff684f41f6f570820a8f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/e9825dd4024b0713b8c7e6d0b28326b3a01a3e7b.png[/img][/url]

It will be used for a very important crafting recipe. With the [b]Necro Rod[/b] + [b]Holy Relic[/b] + [b]Magic Scepter[/b], you can get some pretty crazy Great Skull farming!


[h1]SPIRIT ORBS:[/h1]

These are new consumable items that replace [b]Heart Containers[/b] and [b]Energy Vessels[/b] found in treasure chests. Once you get a [b]Spirit Orb[/b], you can intermediately consume it from your inventory to gain a permanent bonus:

[list]
[*] +1 permanent [b]Max HP[/b]
[*] +36 permanent [b]Max Energy[/b]
[*] +1 permanent [b]Damage[/b]
[*] +1 instant and permanent [b]Level Up[/b]
[/list]


Spirit Orbs can be found in big treasure chests, small skull chests and they can also be crafted in a new structure on the [b]Magic [/b]skill branch:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/7f6edb13b7dd744e4c0bf1040678bf540b30193a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/844e036cfc22d5bf9add34ef4aed14eea7ddc6a4.png[/img][/url]

Crafting Spirit Orbs requires a LOT of [b]Great Skulls[/b], so go find that Necro Rod if you want to speed things up!

And finally...


[h1]SHOVEL UPGRADES![/h1]

Yup, we finally did it! Upgrades for the Shovel item!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/011eeba8c0ef98075f6e0eb430e4ff2d68758e80.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/b29718e6d5aabef30a0541c67e1f7a6370d5d8e5.png[/img][/url]

Each one of those provides new fun effects besides increasing the dig area:

[list]
[*] [b]Water Shovel:[/b] 2x2 dig area, digging irrigates the dirt
[*] [b]Nomad's Shovel:[/b] 3x3 dig area, digging always yields sand
[*] [b]Royal Shovel:[/b] 4x4 dig area, digging always yields ores
[*] [b]Robotic Shovel:[/b] 5x5 dig area, digging always yields rare items
